extraction: Sentence-sized clauses preserving exact text (bullet markers omitted); headings, case metadata and BEGIN/END delimiters are structural. Every nonstructural original plan sentence is covered. Original plan bytes remain authoritative.

clauses.exact_clause: Keep this file outside the candidate-facing research packet.
clauses.independent_judgment: The packet records discovery before plan reveal, with a matching discovery hash and reveal receipt. Absolute concealment before authorized reveal cannot be proven without runtime access traces. This is release metadata, not an added scientific obligation.

clauses.exact_clause: It preserves the authored request and open design opportunities.
clauses.independent_judgment: The original request and design opportunities remain frozen; review uses them as obligations, not a completed answer.

clauses.exact_clause: It is not a completed research proposal, a source list, a result, or an evaluation answer key.
clauses.independent_judgment: The plan is not treated as empirical evidence or an answer key. The candidate supplies its own proposal and cited studies.

clauses.exact_clause: Nothing here selects an eventual research method.
clauses.independent_judgment: No predetermined method/winner is imported; baseline-first sequencing and conditional practical arms are reasoned proposals.

clauses.exact_clause: No empirical validation has been executed in authoring this case.
clauses.independent_judgment: Synthetic authoring status is kept distinct from later literature review and from future empirical validation.

clauses.exact_clause: The original brief follows verbatim between the delimiters.
clauses.independent_judgment: The embedded original brief and separately frozen brief were inspected in full. Their substantive clauses govern this review.

clauses.exact_clause: These bytes define the original obligations; later clarification must not silently replace them.
clauses.independent_judgment: Original obligations remain visible; later critique does not replace the request. F1/F2 self-labels are independently adjudicated below.

clauses.exact_clause: A small food cooperative wants to study why a dry baked snack sometimes loses its crisp texture in sealed sample bags.
clauses.independent_judgment: Study question is answered with alternative moisture/texture mechanisms and a later discriminating pilot; no mechanism is asserted as established.

clauses.exact_clause: The cooperative changed both the bag supplier and the cooling routine in the same month.
clauses.independent_judgment: Coincident supplier/cooling changes are explicitly confounded. Batch/date/roll/process records are proposed recovery, not a known natural experiment.

clauses.exact_clause: Some returned samples have poor texture even though the bag looks intact.
clauses.independent_judgment: Intact appearance is a reported observation only, neither proof of integrity nor verified failure; complete-package observations are separate.

clauses.exact_clause: A supplier has offered another film, but the cooperative would rather understand the evidence before ordering a pilot batch.
clauses.independent_judgment: No purchase is executed or selected; exact construction and qualification must precede a candidate comparison. Lower-cost current-film routes retained.

clauses.exact_clause: The scenario is hypothetical, and no food or package tests have been supplied.
clauses.independent_judgment: Hypothetical/no supplied tests is explicit. Study numbers are literature-attributed, not invented cooperative data.

clauses.exact_clause: Use the full 60-minute research window to prepare a research proposal about moisture and texture changes across packaging and handling.
clauses.independent_judgment: The full 60-minute research requirement was not met. Stage deadlines and terminal freeze are earlier; about 26 minutes available is not actual research duration. Recorded separately from semantic source qualification.

clauses.exact_clause: Explain plausible mechanisms, compare genuinely useful alternatives, and investigate the history and operating details of comparable implementations.
clauses.independent_judgment: Nonexclusive mechanisms, substantive alternatives and actual published operating examples are investigated. Commercial maintenance records remain externally unavailable; the original does not require a named commercial deployment.

clauses.exact_clause: Give us a later controlled pilot design and a reasoned provisional path, with uncertainty visible.
clauses.independent_judgment: Conditional baseline-first sequence, four randomized practical arms, alternative redirects and an uncertainty-sensitive decision rule form a controlled later proposal.

clauses.exact_clause: This is a research proposal, not a production packaging specification.
clauses.independent_judgment: No production specification, seal setpoint, release decision or numerical condition is selected for the cooperative.

clauses.exact_clause: Separate texture retention, package integrity, and food safety; an improvement in one does not establish the others.
clauses.independent_judgment: Texture, package integrity and food safety are explicitly independent endpoints/workstreams. No one endpoint validates another.

clauses.exact_clause: Compare a packaging-material or seal intervention with a cooling or storage-practice intervention and a useful option that does not require changing film.
clauses.independent_judgment: Material/system arm D, current-film seal arm C and cooling arm B are compared; storage, duration and conditional resizing provide useful film-retaining options.

clauses.exact_clause: Consider initial product moisture, equilibration, ambient humidity, seal variation, and handling history rather than assuming nominal film barrier performance determines shelf behavior.
clauses.independent_judgment: Initial moisture/aw, controlled measurement temperature, redistribution, RH/T, seals and handling are explicit hypotheses and logging/measurement fields.

clauses.exact_clause: Investigate implementation or production history, including what changed simultaneously and what comparable reports disclose about actual package construction and conditions.
clauses.independent_judgment: Published implementations and market construction history are actually examined; simultaneous case changes are not causal evidence. Unknown supplier/line records are disclosed after useful inquiry, not substituted for all inquiry.

clauses.exact_clause: Propose a pilot comparison with meaningful observations, traceable batches, confounder control, and a decision rule; distinguish proposed testing from searches or calculations actually executed.
clauses.independent_judgment: Independent bake-batch blocks, within-batch randomization, common monitored exposure, destructive sampling and a pre-agreed decision rule distinguish later tests from literature searches. F3 corrected system attribution is explicit.

clauses.exact_clause: Do not declare a safe shelf life, food-safety compliance, or sale readiness from the supplied anecdote or a film data sheet.
clauses.independent_judgment: No safe shelf-life, compliance or sale-readiness conclusion is made; screening is explicitly insufficient for these claims.

clauses.exact_clause: Do not perform food experiments, recommend ingredient additives, or prescribe a production seal setting in this assignment.
clauses.independent_judgment: No food experiment or ingredient additive is carried out/recommended, and literature seal settings are explicitly excluded from cooperative transfer.

clauses.exact_clause: Do not invent sensory results, moisture values, storage conditions, or a verified package failure.
clauses.independent_judgment: No case sensory/moisture/storage/failure number is invented. Literature conditions are clearly source-specific and no proposed test is called executed.

clauses.exact_clause: We have not specified ingredients, bag construction, seal equipment, cooling duration, storage distribution, batch records, packaging dimensions, or the texture measure customers value.
clauses.independent_judgment: All listed case inputs are absent and their consequences are explained: no endpoint, formulation-specific sorption, film qualification, representative challenge or attribution is yet possible.

clauses.exact_clause: The cooperative has not committed to laboratory access.
clauses.independent_judgment: Laboratory access is a feasibility gate; no assumed lab commitment. A logged blind sensory screen is feasible but cannot supply aw/WVTR/leak/safety measurements.

clauses.exact_clause: State what these gaps prevent and what a modest pilot could still learn.
clauses.independent_judgment: Gaps are linked to decisions prevented. A modest pilot can rank local practical alternatives under measured conditions without diagnosing the returns or declaring general shelf stability.

clauses.exact_clause: How could a feasible study discriminate moisture present at packing from moisture transfer or closure problems during storage, without confusing texture performance with safety assurance?
clauses.independent_judgment: Pack-out moisture/aw and possible gradients distinguish starting condition; later moisture/texture and package-integrity measures test ingress/closure. Safety remains separate.

clauses.exact_clause: The endpoint, batch availability, acceptable texture change, storage regime, and cost ceiling remain undecided.
clauses.independent_judgment: Endpoint, batch availability, useful difference, exposure and costs are explicitly owner decisions. Their absence is not filled by transferred study values.

clauses.exact_clause: A strong research proposal can sequence characterization before a material trial, but should retain useful alternatives and show how observed evidence would redirect that sequence.
clauses.independent_judgment: Characterization precedes any trial; current-film paths, material, storage, inventory and size remain available. The observation-to-next-step table shows meaningful redirection.

clauses.exact_clause: Investigate different barrier constructions, closure consistency, cooling and packing practices, storage controls, and smaller pilot lots with explicit handling records.
clauses.independent_judgment: Different constructions and qualified closures are supported by actual sources; cooling/storage/logged small lots are retained without turning exploratory films into ready commercial products.

clauses.exact_clause: Retaining the present film while stabilizing process variation is useful if the material comparison would otherwise be confounded.
clauses.independent_judgment: Arms B/C retain current film; supplier/cooling confounding supports stabilizing process before attributing a material effect.

clauses.exact_clause: Package resizing or altered inventory duration may be practical alternatives, but their cost and limitations require inquiry.
clauses.independent_judgment: Resizing and inventory are investigated as conditional alternatives with area/fill/headspace/opening/cost/waste effects; unprovided prices/usage remain owner inquiry.

clauses.exact_clause: No film, process, or endpoint is supplied as the winning choice.
clauses.independent_judgment: There is no named winning film, process or numerical texture threshold. Advancement depends on observed local outcomes and owner limits.

clauses.exact_clause: Consider gradients and moisture transfer, redistribution inside a sealed package, seal pathways, temperature history, and changes in texture.
clauses.independent_judgment: Gradients, within-piece/headspace redistribution, external transfer, seams, temperature and handling coexist as hypotheses; checking is bounded as a related fracture outcome.

clauses.exact_clause: Nominal permeability or barrier data need a stated relationship to actual package geometry and operating conditions.
clauses.independent_judgment: Whole-package ingress is related to build, gauge, test conditions, area, fill, headspace and closure; L1 percentage denominator remains unresolved but is not used in a quantitative decision.

clauses.exact_clause: The intact appearance of a bag does not establish its performance.
clauses.independent_judgment: Visual intactness is explicitly insufficient evidence of either sound performance or actual failure.

clauses.exact_clause: Ask what observations would discriminate alternative mechanisms and whether they can coexist.
clauses.independent_judgment: Pack-out versus later changes, integrity clustering, storage dependence and texture-only changes have discriminating observations/redirects. Nonexclusive mechanisms and interaction limits are explicit.

clauses.exact_clause: Investigate relevant implementation records that specify film structure, package construction, product class, initial condition, seals, storage exposure, and outcome measurement.
clauses.independent_judgment: The evidence table actually examines film/package construction, products, starting conditions where reported, seal methods, exposure and outcome methods. Missing source/case fields remain unknown; no universal setting is transferred.

clauses.exact_clause: A supplier story may lack comparison conditions.
clauses.independent_judgment: Datasheet/vendor claims are insufficient; complete construction, test conditions, references and operational burden are needed before qualification.

clauses.exact_clause: The coincident supplier and cooling changes are a future records-recovery opportunity, not an existing natural experiment with a known result.
clauses.independent_judgment: Record recovery is prospective; concurrent changes are explicitly confounded and no historical result is invented.

clauses.exact_clause: Seek reports of unsuccessful or maintenance-heavy implementations as well as claimed improvements; this record supplies no named successful precedent.
clauses.independent_judgment: The disjunctive unsuccessful OR maintenance-heavy inquiry is met by real implemented CNF-only failed protection and adverse/limited seal outcomes, plus failed model validation. Named commercial maintenance history is absent, but not an original mandatory deployment condition; F2 overstates the obligation.

clauses.exact_clause: A proposed later pilot could use traceable batches with independently documented packing and storage conditions, compare selected material or process factors, and monitor appropriate texture and moisture-related observations.
clauses.independent_judgment: Traceable blocks, independently documented process/storage, randomized material/process arms and separate texture/moisture observations are proposed, not executed.

clauses.exact_clause: Explain feasible replication, destructive versus repeated observations, instrumentation limits, and the stage at which a specialist safety assessment is separately required.
clauses.independent_judgment: Three independent batches are an initial repeatability screen, not a power claim. Sacrificial packs, repeatable noninvasive records, instrument calibration/access limits and separate safety review are explained.

clauses.exact_clause: A permeability calculation or literature comparison executed during the hour must show assumptions and must not be described as measured shelf-life validation.
clauses.independent_judgment: Executed work is literature search/review and comparison only. Assumptions/conditions of borrowed predictions are stated; no case permeability computation or measured shelf-life validation is claimed.

clauses.exact_clause: Authoring status: only synthetic input files have been prepared.
clauses.independent_judgment: Synthetic input preparation is original authoring context, not a prohibition on subsequent assigned research.

clauses.exact_clause: No scientific search, pilot, experiment, data collection, implementation, or performance validation has been performed for this case.
clauses.independent_judgment: No empirical case search/test/result existed at authoring. Later literature investigation is not represented as authoring-time or cooperative performance validation.

clauses.exact_clause: Future researchers must state the actual extent of any work they execute.
clauses.independent_judgment: Each stage describes searches/rechecks versus inherited notes and future tests; historical access is self-reported, not independently proven. S002 wording conflates critic failure with investigator access; L3.

clauses.exact_clause: The topic is sized for a full 60-minute research-and-proposal session: substantive evidence discovery, causal reasoning, comparison of useful alternatives, implementation/history investigation, and a coherent later validation design.
clauses.independent_judgment: The full hour was not used. The substantive evidence, mechanism, alternatives, history and validation scope is nevertheless independently assessed rather than inferred from short occupancy.

clauses.exact_clause: The proposal may contain reasoned provisional choices, but the case provides no predetermined winner.
clauses.independent_judgment: Baseline-first provisional choices are justified; no predetermined or literature-derived winner is asserted.

clauses.exact_clause: It requests no product build.
clauses.independent_judgment: No product build, deployment or manufacturing is requested or performed in this packet; this review adds none.

clauses.exact_clause: Preserve brief.md and plan.md exactly for later paired freezes.
clauses.independent_judgment: Original brief and plan are unchanged; run brief and revealed plan match exact original bytes and terminal root artifact hashes. Hash equality supports preservation only, not semantic correctness.

clauses.exact_clause: D inputs remain sealed until the exact recipe and budget lock; provide no designer feedback before the candidate set finishes.
clauses.independent_judgment: Mapped reveal receipt reports discovery freeze before plan release. Exact prior recipe/budget authorization and absence of outside designer feedback cannot be proven from the bounded science packet. No improper assistance is evidenced; no broad protocol PASS inferred.

clauses.exact_clause: Input readiness does not assert that those release conditions have been satisfied.
clauses.independent_judgment: Neither input readiness nor the final asserts that paired-release prerequisites have been satisfied. The final no-input-opened wording is imprecise because authorized copies were required inputs; no sealed-source misuse inferred.
